description: Trace the consequential decisions in a community you run — the approval audit log, newest-first. Each entry names WHO acted, WHEN, to WHICH event, and — for approvals — at WHAT deal terms (producer%/community%, or 'distribution only'), plus any Space confirmed; rejects carry the reason; Space assign/reassign/unassign carry the Space + slot. Paginated (limit≤100, cursor) and filterable (action, event_id). Requires community_id. Read-only.
name: list_community_activity
title: List Community Activity
